days.title: Northern Reserves and Trails
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Hackelsberg (Jois)
stops.detail: The nature reserves Hackelsberg (Jois), Jungerberg (Jois) and Thenauriegel (Breitenbrunn am Neusiedler See) are located in the nature park.

stops.name: Panoramawanderweg
stops.detail: In addition to the 22-kilometer-long Panorama Hiking Trail connecting all five communities of the nature park, there are local and sometimes cross-community hiking trails in the individual towns.

days.title: Culture and Nature in the South and West
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Donnerskirchen
stops.detail: In the river delta near Donnerskirchen, the lake's reed belt reaches its greatest width of five kilometers.

stops.name: Ludlloch (Bärenhöhle)
stops.detail: Natural monuments located in the nature park are the Ludlloch (Bear Cave) in Winden am See, a winter lime tree in Purbach am Neusiedler See and a pedunculate oak in Donnerskirchen.

stops.name: Skulpturenpark Bildhauers Wander Bertoni
stops.detail: The sculpture park of the sculptor Wander Bertoni in Winden am See covers an area of around four hectares and contains around 480 objects.
